profile.headline: Senior Software Developer in Test and Measurement Org
profile.summary: I'm a graduate student in Mechanical Engineering with experience in the field of control systems, robotics and design

positions.title: Graduate Teaching Assistant
positions.description:
ME370: Vibration of Mechanical Systems under Prof. Alok Sinha (Fa17) and Prof. Liming Chang (SP18)
ME456: Industrial Robotic Applications under Prof. Alok Sinha (Fa18)

positions.title: Mechanical Engineering Intern
positions.description:
Skills used: Fusion 360, 3D printing, Raspberry Pi

Components design and development using 3D Printing
o Designed flow-path components in Fusion 360, worked with FDM and SLA based 3D printers for prototyping
o Explored different manufacturing techniques for the production of a 200 µm closed channel component, improved design to facilitate production using SLA printer
o Programmed raspberry pi with two cameras to setup remote monitoring system for 3D prints

positions.title: Verification Engineer
positions.description:
Skills used: HDLs (Verilog, SystemVerilog and VHDL), Python and tcl scripting

Diagnosis of Intel’s FPGA synthesis tool ‘Quartus’  
o Performed Equivalence Checking (EC) on 40 designs in Verilog/VHDL to identify logical bugs using EC tools 
o Root-caused the issues and created unit test-cases that highlight synthesis logic bugs (identified 15 bugs)
o Developed scripts in python & tcl to automate the checking process and report generation

positions.title: Undergraduate Teaching Assistant
positions.description:
MEL211: Kinematics and Dynamics of Machines under Prof. Sudipto Mukherjee

Awarded certificate of appreciation by Dean of Undergraduate studies for exceptional work as TA

positions.title: Industrial Attachment (IA)
positions.description:
Skills used: LabView, SolidWorks

Product development for heavy duty vehicle overhaul and maintenance
o Studied hydraulic & mechanical system of HMIVT & controlling sequence used in HMX 1600 Transmission System
o Developed parameter acquisition package for Transmission Control Module (TCM), capable of logging transmission data continuously for 52 days
o Designed multipurpose fault detection & analysis solution with intuitive GUI for logged parameter using LabView

honors.title: Appreciation Certificate
honors.description: Certificate of appreciation from ISRO for the development of Condition Monitoring & Health Assessment system for high speed turbo pump bearing of cryogenic engine

honors.title: Nayyar Perwez Shahabuddin Medal
honors.description: Awarded for being best graduating undergraduate student of the Mechanical Engineering Department
honors.issuer: Issued by Indian Institute of Technology Delhi · Jan 2016

volunteerExperiences.description:
o Taught basic science to underprivileged high school students for various entrance examinations
o Helped National Association of Blinds (NAB) by assisting visually impaired kids in studying
o Volunteered in various social awareness drives in slums, cleanliness drives inside and outside campus

publications.title: Principal Component Analysis Based Approach for Health Assessment of Rolling Element Bearing
publications.publisher: 23rd International Congress on Sound & Vibration (ICSV23) · Jan 1, 2016

organizations.name: Robotics Club, IIT Delhi
organizations.description:
o Led a team of 18 to represent IIT Delhi in DD-MIT ROBOCON, India’s largest robotics competition 
o Ranked 2nd in Super League matches among 85 teams, awarded Best Innovative Design Award for ingenious 5 armed mobile badminton playing robot design, one of the best performance of IIT Delhi
o Restructured club’s induction process to enhance interests of students; team size increased two folds
o Conceptualized, designed competitions & workshops for freshers, 350+ students participated
